_about: One person, one link (docs/44 Appendix G, the owner 2026-11-18): a device either follows a Sukrara (the link, the
default) or reads one other source, never both. Every app passes these cases (Android LinkContractTest, Mac
LinkContractTests).
'pick': what picking a source asks. 'linked' = none | active | ended (the wearer removed this device, or the follow
can't go on); 'picked' = a sources.json id. 'asks' = keepFollowing (the question that says what the link already
brings, whichever source was picked; Keep following is the default, Stop following goes on to the leave questions) |
leave (straight to the leave questions: there is nothing left to keep following) | null (no question).
'leave': which questions leaving the link asks, in order. 'settingsFrom' = what the device used while linked
(wearer = Their settings, custom = This device's own); 'theirs' = the wearer's mirrored settings: none (never
received), defaults (received, every mirrored row at its schema default) or differ; 'history' = the device holds
readings or treatments received through the link; 'personChange' = Android only: Whose glucose changes with the
leave, so the history is deleted (asked as that deletion, with Export first) instead of asked keep / delete.
'questions' = settings (Keep their settings / Sukrara's defaults) | history (Keep it / Delete it) | deleteHistory.
'result' = the settings the device keeps when no settings question is asked (own = its own as they are; defaults =
the mirrored rows at the schema defaults; theirs = the wearer's mirrored rows copied as its own).
'behind': a follow record found at start behind another source (a device updated from before one person, one link).
'asks' = keepFollowing (it is live: Keep following {name}? as if the source in use was just picked; Keep following
makes the link the source again, the other source's account kept; Stop following goes on to the leave questions,
the source in use staying; a leave is final, so it is never made unasked) | leave (it ended: left at once, no
question, the history kept apart, the settings untouched) | null (no follow record).
'defaults' = the preselected answers: nothing the person sees shifts, nothing is lost.
'fence': leaving with Keep, the next source continues the kept history: its backfill fills gaps but never replaces
a kept reading at or before 'fence_s' (the last kept reading); after the fence the rank rule (dedup.json) applies.
Each case: 'stored' then 'incoming' (each [seconds, source, mg/dL]; one batch) -> 'kept', sorted by time then source.
'after': what a device takes from a link it left, or reads beside another source: nothing. Each id is a thing the
link brings; every app's test runs a non-link source with a follow record's leftovers present and checks each.

the follow ended, the link picked again (a new invite)

leave.name: their settings in use and different from the defaults: both questions
their settings equal the defaults: both answers would give the same settings
their settings never arrived: the device ran on the defaults
this device's own settings: nothing to ask, they stay
Android: someone else's glucose to yours deletes the history (asked as that)
Android: a person change with nothing received

behind.name: a live follow behind another source is asked about, never left unasked
an ended follow behind another source is left at start
no follow record behind the source

it fills a gap in the kept history
after the fence the rank rule applies
a sensor reading just after the window of the last kept one is new

after.what: no relay connection and no Bluetooth to the wearer's phone
the wearer's settings are never applied; Settings from is not shown; every pane is editable
the wearer's name and picture appear nowhere (card, alerts, notification, widgets, Settings)
no path badge or blocked-feature warning of the follow (Bluetooth, internet)
no mirrored alert events or answers; the device's own engine runs on the source
the escalation switch (a very low nobody answers on their phone) is not shown
Treatments and Add Treatment use the source's own log, never the wearer's
the sensor and its life come from the source, never the wearer's
the no-data reason is the source's, never the link's (not following, their phone off, removed)
no follow record or key is kept once the device left; the wearer was told (PROTOCOL-v2 leave)
